_note: Shown on the home page when a student picks 'Motivational quotes' in Settings. Original lines; one per day, tap for another.
lines: The expert in anything was once a beginner who kept going.
Understanding beats memorising. Ask why until it clicks.
A little every day adds up to a lot by exam season.
Confusion is the feeling of learning something new.
Practise the routine until your hands know it before your head does.
Done is better than perfect. Start the topic.
Every patient you'll ever see is a reason to learn this well.
Progress hides in the days that feel ordinary.
Explain it out loud. If you can teach it, you know it.
Your future clinic starts with today's revision.
Rest well, revise well. Both count.
One clear page of notes beats ten messy ones.
